query: Equinix interconnection revenue growth latest quarter

output.content:
Equinix’s latest reported quarter is Q2 2026 (ended June 30, 2026), in which interconnection revenue was **$256 million**. [[1]] [[2]] 

That represents **10.8% year-over-year growth** from **$231 million in Q2 2025**, and **2.0% sequential growth** from **$251 million in Q1 2026**. [[2]] 

Equinix also added a record **9,700 net interconnections** during Q2, supporting the revenue growth. [[2]]

sources.title: Equinix Reports Second-Quarter Results, Raises 2026 Guidance and Long-Term Outlook :: Equinix, Inc. (EQIX)
